Ekta Kapoor Gives a Shoutout to Kanika Mann as ‘Kanika Mann Era Begins’ Takes Over Times Square

Spread the love

Kanika Mann’s Bigg Boss 20 journey has begun on a truly global note. The actress, who has been creating a strong buzz even before entering the reality show, is now shining on the iconic Times Square in New York, marking a major milestone for her growing popularity.

The excitement around Kanika had already taken over social media before her grand entry into the Bigg Boss 20 house. The hashtag #KanikaEraBegins trended at No. 1 for two consecutive days, including the day of her entry, as fans came together to celebrate the beginning of what they have been calling the ‘Kanika Mann Era’.

Now, as her presence lights up Times Square, the global moment has added another layer to the buzz surrounding the actress. The post on the social media expressed how overwhelming the love has been, reflecting on her journey from being a simple girl from Haryana to trend globally and appear on Times Square.

Adding to the celebrations, Ekta Kapoor gave a special shoutout to Kanika Mann as she continues her Bigg Boss journey and shines on the Times Square. Ekta Kapoor’s gesture further amplified the excitement around Kanika’s latest achievement.

From dominating social media trends to making her presence felt on one of the world’s most iconic locations, Kanika’s Bigg Boss 20 journey has already become a talking point. Her fandom has made it clear that the excitement around her extends far beyond the television screen.

With ‘Kanika Mann Era Begins’ already taking over the internet and her Times Square moment adding an international spotlight, Kanika Mann’s Bigg Boss journey has certainly started on a high. And with her stint inside the house only beginning, it seems the Kanika Mann era is just getting started.
